description: Sends one application to the employer: the only tool that applies. It takes the preparation_id, review_digest and authority_digest of the packet the member reviewed (get_applications packet), or approve_only for a job marked approveOnly (an approve-first job with no packet yet), which Applystead prepares and sends.

approve_only.description: true to apply to a job marked approveOnly in get_applications ready or approvals; it has no packet, and Applystead prepares and sends it.

authority_digest.description: The packet's authorityDigest from get_applications packet.

preparation_id.description: The packet's preparationId from get_applications packet.

review_digest.description: The packet's reviewDigest from get_applications packet.

name: apply_to_job
title: Apply to a job
